title: Dive Into You leads save Jeong Woojae through time slip in South Korea drama
excerpt: Dive Into You leads save Jeong Woojae through time slip in South Korea drama
content:
From episode 1, Dive Into You, which shocked viewers with the male lead's death, began its main story in earnest through time slip.

On March 3, the Disney+·Channel A drama Dive Into You (written by Kim Bogum and I-ON, directed by So Jaehyun) showed Younha (Kim Jiyeon) and Younha‑ru (Jang Se Hyuk) time slipping to the past in 2011, flaunting a fantastic twin teamwork and successfully changing the past of their close friend Jeong Woojae (Park Seoham), delivering a thrill.

Younha and Younha‑ru, who returned to the night before the awards ceremony when Jeong Woojae died, expected that, according to the original timeline, the stalker targeting Younha would appear at the awards ceremony disguised as a flower delivery person, so they planned to catch the stalker at the ceremony and save Jeong Woojae, making thorough preparations, but the sudden appearance of Jeong Woojae completely messed up their plans.

Because the future had changed, the person who delivered flowers to Younha turned out not to be the stalker but Jeong Woojae, who had disappeared after giving up judo under threats from loan sharks in the past of 2011. To make matters worse, even though the future was altered, the stalker still appeared before Younha by a means other than posing as a flower delivery person and threatened her, and Jeong Woojae was stabbed in Younha's place and died, delivering another shock.

Witnessing the death of her first love again before her eyes, Younha was gripped by deep despair and guilt, adding to the poignancy. Watching this, Younha‑ru said there was a way to get rid of the loan sharks who had tormented Jeong Woojae and persuaded Younha, and the two once again time slipped to 2011 using a camcorder.

With their souls swapped as they fell into the past, Younha and Younha‑ru met the loan sharks who had been pressuring Jeong Woojae and declared they would repay the debt. Before coming to the past, Younha‑ru had memorized the winning lottery numbers and, before meeting the loan sharks, had already purchased the lottery tickets.

While Younha‑ru dealt with the loan sharks using the winning lottery tickets, Younha recalled Jeong Woojae's sparkling eyes when he dreamed of becoming a national judo athlete and winning a gold medal. She then got a promise from Jeong Woojae that he would do judo again, telling him, "Live loved so much that everyone is desperate to protect you. That is how you repay it."

Younha's sincerity that wished for Jeong Woojae to shine not as the Jeong Woojae who died twice protecting others but as a judo athlete moved viewers' hearts.
